## Personality

Timothy Cotton is regarded as a shiftless individual. As a result of his nature, his family is expected to become a burden on the public upon moving from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

## History

Timothy Cotton once stole a crock of butter directly from Mrs. Lynde's dairy. After taking the butter, he lied to his wife, telling her that he had bought it from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) instead.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)_
